core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abasi corresponds to Arabic عباسي, a nisba adjective meaning “of or relating to ʿAbbās” or associated with the Abbasid line; it does not mean “servant of Abbas.”
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The Arabic suffix ـي commonly forms a relational adjective. The previous translations “servant of Abbas” and “Abbas's servant” are not supported by the recorded form عباسي and have been corrected.

etymology.morphology: Simple lexical item used as a name.
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عباسي is an established Arabic lexical item used unchanged as a given name.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.
